summary_en: 386,256 shares to be cancelled (2.54% of shares outstanding). Post-cancellation issued shares: 14,811,344. Effective date 2026-09-17. Conditional on approval of stock split (effective 2026-09-18) at extraordinary shareholder meeting scheduled 2026-08-28.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Sunny Side Up Group's board of directors resolved on 2026-07-17 to cancel 386,256 treasury shares (2.54% of shares outstanding) pursuant to the Companies Act article 178. The shares to be cancelled represent the entirety of treasury shares held by the company as of 2026-07-10. The cancellation is scheduled for 2026-09-17, and post-cancellation issued shares outstanding will total 14,811,344. The cancellation is conditional upon approval by an extraordinary shareholder meeting (scheduled 2026-08-28) of a concurrent stock split with effective date 2026-09-18, as detailed in a separate notice published on the same date.
